events.text: Sarta had a population of approximately 3,382.
events.subject: self
events.quote: it had a population of approximately 3,382 in 2017

events.text: The village was incorporated into the Ottoman Empire.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The village was incorporated into the Ottoman Empire in 1517

events.text: The village appeared in the tax registers as being in the nahiya of Jabal Qubal in the liwa of Nablus.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1596 it appeared in the tax registers

events.text: It was noted as a village Serata, part of the Jurat Merda district, south of Nablus.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1838 it was noted as a village Serata

events.text: French explorer Victor Guérin travelled through the village.
events.subject: self
events.quote: French explorer Victor Guérin travelled through the village in 1870

events.text: The Palestine Exploration Funds Survey of Western Palestine described Serta as a small stone village.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1882 , the Palestine Exploration Funds Survey of Western Palestine described Serta as a small stone village

events.text: Sarta had a population of 275 Muslims and 1 Jew in the census.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the 1922 census of Palestine conducted by the British Mandate authorities , Sarta had a population of 275 Muslims and 1 Jew

events.text: Sarta's population increased to 317, all Muslim, in the census.
events.subject: self
events.quote: increasing in the 1931 census to 317 , all Muslim , in a total of 76 houses

events.text: Sarta's population was 420, all Muslims, in the statistics.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the 1945 statistics the population was 420 , all Muslims

events.text: Sarta has been under Israeli occupation since the Six-Day War.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since the Six-Day War in 1967 , Sarta has been under Israeli occupation .

events.text: After the 1995 accords, 16.8 % of the village land is defined as Area B.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After the 1995 accords , 16.8 % of the village land is defined as Area B

events.text: Israel confiscated 353 dunams of village land for the establishment of the Israeli settlement of Barkan.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Israel has confiscated 353 dunams of village land for the establishment of the Israeli settlement of Barkan .

events.text: POICA reported land confiscation, tree burning and uprooting campaigns against the Village of Sarta.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Tree Burning and Uprooting Campaigns against the Village of Sarta , 23 September , 2004

events.text: Israeli Occupation Forces embarked on the expansion of Burkan Industrial Compound.
events.subject: other

events.text: Palestinian land was bulldozed for colonial expansion in Sarta village.
